text:
{collection}.{field}: type changes from {from} to {to}.
Clients would merge and read existing values differently.
Add a new field instead, and deprecate {collection}.{field}.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a field's type changes (for a set, its element's type).
